### 1) What is on the screen
The frame shows a left-hand column of graphics about x0-408 wide against a huge black void on the right. Top is a blue block x0,y64,w408,h416 with flat blue fills and scattered speckles, middle is a green blocky structure x0,y510,w400,h230 with a white wire box and clipped white text, bottom is a striped platform x0,y768,w224,h176. A small white dithered blob sits isolated at x578,y848,w222,h88. The eye goes first to the high-contrast white text box at x117,y608,w108,h88 reading BAS: / SOU' because it is the only white on dark. What the player is being asked to do cannot be seen - no PRESS START, no player, no enemies, no HUD, no prompt is visible.

### 2) Does it look like a real NES game
(a) PASS - palette count reads as NES: measured 8 distinct colours, all 64-entry NES palette, inside the 25-colour ceiling of 12 background + 12 sprite + 1 backdrop.
(b) PASS - shading is flat, one colour per shape, no gradient banding: blue fills and green fills are solid, no alpha.
(c) FAIL - sprites do not read at a glance: I cannot separate OAM sprites from background; the white blob at x578,y848,w222,h88 has no clear silhouette and the text shares pure white with background dashes.
(d) PASS - no anti-aliasing and no soft edges: all edges are hard 4x blocks, including text and window borders.
(e) FAIL - background colour changes do not land on the 16 x 16 pixel boundary: 4px-high in-file grey streaks equal 1 NES px high at x0,y96,w408,h16 and x0,y444,w200,h12 cut across tiles, and the blue block ends in a stepped edge at x200,y448,w208,h32 instead of a whole 8 x 8 tile edge. Measured facts outrank impression for count, but do not save alignment.

### 3) Composition and text
Crowded on the left x0-408 from y64 to y944, empty on the right x408-1024,y0,w616,h960 which is ~60% of the frame and matches the measured 66.2% dominant colour. The focal white box at x117,y608,w108,h88 is not where a title needs it - off-center left, clipped, with no surrounding title layout. Text region 1: upper line at x132,y616,w84,h32 reading BAS: . Text region 2: lower line at x132,y652,w84,h32 reading SOU' clipped on the right. At 256 x 240 that is 8x8 glyphs scaled 4x and it is illegible without guessing because the right-most glyphs are cut mid-tile and the box border is open/incomplete. The worst one is the lower line at x132,y652,w84,h32 - missing final letters, stray white pixels, not on the glyph grid.

### 4) What looks AI generated or off
Blunt: this reads as a broken capture / bad generation, not a handmade shipped title.
- Stray-pixel noise: dozens of isolated 4x4 grey/black/white pixels across the blue field x0,y64,w408,h416 with no 8 x 8 tile structure.
- Text not on glyph grid: BAS: / SOU' at x117,y608,w108,h88 clipped mid-character, right border missing.
- Borders not whole tiles: blue to black step at x200,y448,w208,h32 and grey 1-NES-pixel lines drifting horizontally.
- Detail without structure: green building x0,y510,w400,h230 dissolves into dither noise with no readable windows/tiles.
- Dithered blob at x578,y848,w222,h88 with checkerboard tail and uneven outline, floating in black with no shadow/ground, reads as prompt debris.
- Composition as prompt: left sliver of game + 60% black void, not a designed 256 x 240 layout.

### 5) Five concrete fixes
1. Region x0,y64,w408,h416 - delete all isolated 1x1 NES-pixel speckles and fill solid to NES $21 blue for upper half and $12 light blue for lower half, no grey $10 pixels left in sky.
2. Region x117,y608,w108,h88 - erase broken box and redraw on 8-pixel grid in-file 32-pixel grid as 14x5 tiles white NES $30 border with centered 8x8 text PRESS START, move box right by 64 file pixels to x181 to clear green post.
3. Region x412,y0,w612,h960 - fill black void with continued background tiles copied from x0,y64,w200,h416 shifted by whole 16 NES pixels, 64 file pixels, so nametable is full and backdrop is NES $0F black only.
4. Region x578,y848,w222,h88 - replace checker blob with a solid 2x 8x16 sprite using NES sprite white $30 + grey $00, 32x16 NES pixels, no checker dither, clear silhouette.
5. Region x0,y768,w224,h176 - simplify bottom to two 16x16 attribute blocks: white NES $30 dash tiles on dark NES $02 blue-black, remove diagonal noise, align all dashes to 32 file-pixel vertical grid.

Readability: 2/10
